section: Mercedes-Benz in Formula One > Mercedes-AMG Petronas Formula One Team (2010–present)

entities.name: Mercedes-AMG Petronas Formula One Team
entities.description: Team Mercedes GP hired German drivers Nico Rosberg, and seven-time world champion Michael Schumacher, who returned to Formula One after a three-year absence, and Nick Heidfeld as the test and reserve driver.

entities.name: Nico Rosberg
entities.description: Nico Rosberg finished on the podium three times, scoring third places at Sepang, Shanghai, and Silverstone.

entities.name: Michael Schumacher
entities.description: Michael Schumacher had a disappointing return, being beaten by his teammate and finishing the season without a single race win, podium, pole position, or fastest lap for the first time since his début season in 1991.

entities.name: Nick Heidfeld
entities.description: Nick Heidfeld was hired as the test and reserve driver.
The team's performance during 2010 was not so competitive as under Brawn.
